verses.1: Therefore, holy brothers, who share in the heavenly calling, set your focus on Jesus, the apostle and high priest whom we confess.
verses.2: He was faithful to the One who appointed Him, just as Moses was faithful in all God’s house. + 3:2 Literally just as Moses in all His house ; SBL just as Moses in His house
verses.3: For Jesus has been counted worthy of greater glory than Moses, just as the builder of a house has greater honor than the house itself.
verses.4: And every house is built by someone, but God is the builder of everything.
verses.5: Now Moses was faithful as a servant in all God’s house, + 3:5 Numbers 12:7|NUM 12:7 testifying to what would be spoken later.
verses.6:
But Christ is faithful as the Son over God’s house. And we are His house, if we hold firmly + 3:6 NE, WH, BYZ, and TR include to the end . to our confidence and the hope of which we boast.
 Do Not Harden Your Hearts
 ( Psalm 95:1–11|PSA 95:1-11 )
verses.7:
Therefore, as the Holy Spirit says:
 “Today, if you hear His voice,
verses.8:
do not harden your hearts,
 as you did in the rebellion,
 in the day of testing in the wilderness,
verses.9:
where your fathers tested and tried Me,
 and for forty years saw My works.
verses.10:
Therefore I was angry with that generation,
 and I said,
 ‘Their hearts are always going astray,
 and they have not known My ways.’
verses.11:
So I swore on oath in My anger,
 ‘They shall never enter My rest.’” + 3:11 Psalm 95:7–11|PSA 95:7-11 (see also LXX) 
 The Peril of Unbelief
verses.12: See to it, brothers, that none of you has a wicked heart of unbelief that turns away from the living God.
verses.13: But exhort one another daily, as long as it is called today, so that none of you may be hardened by sin’s deceitfulness.
verses.14: We have come to share in Christ if we hold firmly to the end the assurance we had at first.
verses.15:
As it has been said:
 “Today, if you hear His voice,
 do not harden your hearts,
 as you did in the rebellion.” + 3:15 Psalm 95:7–8|PSA 95:7-8
verses.16: For who were the ones who heard and rebelled? Were they not all those Moses led out of Egypt?
verses.17: And with whom was God angry for forty years? Was it not with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?
verses.18: And to whom did He swear that they would never enter His rest? Was it not to those who disobeyed?
verses.19: So we see that it was because of their unbelief that they were unable to enter.
